svg.title: AirDial: thumbs-up dictation and AI agent
svg.desc: Left: a person holds a thumbs-up and speaks; AirDial holds the Fn / Globe key, so a dictation app types the words into a text field. Right: a sentence starting with "AGI" is handed to a Claude computer-use agent, which opens tomorrow in the calendar.
svg.text: Holds the Fn / 🌐 key (e.g. Wispr Flow dictation)
👍 Hold a thumbs-up to dictate — start with “AGI” to hand the command to an AI agent
